title: Expanding economic opportunity with AI
summary: OpenAI is launching a Jobs Platform and new Certifications to connect workers with jobs, training, and certifications. Learn how we’re expanding economic opportunity and making AI skills more accessible.
body: OpenAI is launching a Jobs Platform and new Certifications to connect workers with jobs, training, and certifications. Learn how we’re expanding economic opportunity and making AI skills more accessible.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布推出全新的就业平台（Jobs Platform）与认证体系（Certifications），旨在帮助劳动力市场对接工作机会、培训资源和相关技能认证，从而扩大经济机遇并普及AI技能。原始信息显示：OpenAI is launching a Jobs Platform and new Certifications to connect workers with jobs, training, and certifications. Learn how we’re expanding economic opportunity and making AI skills more accessible.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Expanding economic opportunity with AI”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI推出全新的就业平台和认证体系，以扩大AI技能的可及性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
